reviews.note: The sharpest economic mechanism he has given: headline growth and real conditions diverging, with AI as the cause of the divergence. Directly testable against GDP versus real-income and default data.
Worth flagging that he lives in this area, so a prediction of revival and inflow there is not independent of his own interests.
Sourced from a bank research note he read out, so treat it as commentary carrying a date rather than an independent vision.
